CosignSignature.description: Cosign configuration for OCI artifact signature verification.

certificateIdentity.description: Certificate identity pattern for keyless verification (regex).

certificateOidcIssuer.description: Certificate OIDC issuer pattern for keyless verification (regex).

keyless.description: Enable keyless verification via Fulcio/Rekor (OIDC identity-based).

publicKey.description: PEM-encoded public key for static key verification.

ModuleEnvVar.description: An environment variable set by a Module.

append.description: Append to the variable's existing value with the platform's path separator instead of replacing it. Default: `false`.

name.description: Variable name, as exported into the container or shell environment.

platforms.description: Platform tags gating this entry alone. Empty means every platform the declaring module is not already gated off of. Tags are matched against the machine's OS, distro, and arch; use `macos` for macOS. A pod is a Linux container, so the pod-mutating webhook injects an entry only when this is empty or names `linux` — nothing about a pod can answer a distro or arch tag.

ModuleFileSpec.description: A file managed by a Module.

source.description: Path to the file inside the module artifact.

target.description: Destination path the file is deployed to inside the pod or on the machine.

ModuleScripts.description: Scripts that run during module lifecycle.

postApply.description: Command run once after the module's files and packages are in place. Omitted, nothing runs.

ModuleSignature.description: Signature configuration for a Module's OCI artifact.

cosign.description: How the artifact's cosign signature is verified. Omitted, no signature is required of this module.

MountPolicy.description: Controls how a module is exposed to pod containers.

oneOf.description: Mount into all declared containers with volumeMount and env vars.
Stage the CSI volume on the pod but do not mount into declared containers. Only accessible via ephemeral debug containers.

PackageEntry.description: An entry in a Module's package list with optional per-platform overrides.

name.description: Default package name, used on every platform `platforms` names no override for.

depends.description: Names of other `Module` resources that must be applied first.

env.description: Environment variables this module contributes to containers that mount it.

files.description: Files this module deploys out of its artifact.

mountPolicy.description: Controls how the module is mounted in pods. `Always` (default): CSI volume + volumeMount on all declared containers + env vars. `Debug`: CSI volume only — no volumeMount or env on declared containers. Only accessible via ephemeral debug containers (`kubectl cfgd debug`).

ociArtifact.description: OCI reference the module's content is pulled from (`ghcr.io/acme/nvim:1.2.0`). Omitted, the module carries its content inline and nothing is fetched.

packages.description: Packages this module installs, each with optional per-platform name overrides.

scripts.description: Lifecycle commands run around the module's deployment.

signature.description: How the artifact's provenance is verified before it is admitted. Omitted, verification is governed by the cluster policy alone.
